# OpenFOAM

*aka majordome.openfoam*

The primary goal of `majordome.openfoam` is to replace fragile regex parsers and other packages for manipulation of OpenFOAM files with a lossless AST parser and an intuitive Python object model. It provides a thin wrapper over `majordome-foam` for parsing and writing OpenFOAM files; utilities for case post-processing efficiently; and a (Linux-only) case run management engine.
